mapper.select: select count(*) as total_count, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'CANDIDATE' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as candidate_count, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'GOLDEN' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as golden_count, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'FROZEN' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as frozen_count, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'DEPRECATED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as deprecated_count, count(distinct nullif(baseline_version, '')) as baseline_version_count, max(updated_at) as latest_updated_at from test_design_evaluation_sample where (#{projectId} is null or #{projectId} = '' or project_id = #{projectId}) and (#{promptKey} is null or #{promptKey} = '' or prompt_key = #{promptKey})

mapper.insert: insert into test_design_calibration_run ( id, project_id, prompt_key, prompt_version, baseline_version, run_mode, status, sample_count, golden_sample_count, task_count, candidate_count, step_complete_percent, expected_complete_percent, low_confidence_percent, error_percent, duplicate_key_collision_count, feedback_signal_count, readiness_status, readiness_blocking_count, readiness_warning_count, regression_count, baseline_digest, result_digest, notes, run_by, created_at ) values ( cast(#{id} as uuid), #{projectId}, #{promptKey}, #{promptVersion}, #{baselineVersion}, #{runMode}, #{status}, #{sampleCount}, #{goldenSampleCount}, #{taskCount}, #{candidateCount}, #{stepCompletePercent}, #{expectedCompletePercent}, #{lowConfidencePercent}, #{errorPercent}, #{duplicateKeyCollisionCount}, #{feedbackSignalCount}, #{readinessStatus}, #{readinessBlockingCount}, #{readinessWarningCount}, #{regressionCount}, #{baselineDigest}, #{resultDigest}, #{notes}, #{runBy}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: with scoped_runs as ( select * from test_design_calibration_run where (#{projectId} is null or #{projectId} = '' or project_id = #{projectId}) and (#{promptKey} is null or #{promptKey} = '' or prompt_key = #{promptKey}) ), latest_run as ( select status, created_at from scoped_runs order by created_at desc limit 1 ) select count(*) as total_run_count, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'PASSED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as passed_run_count, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'WARNING' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as warning_run_count, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'BLOCKED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as blocked_run_count, (select status from latest_run) as latest_status, (select created_at from latest_run) as latest_run_at from scoped_runs
